title: Eric’s ant/pos
desc: Completing basic exercises to build a solid foundation, purpose is to strengthen the entire body to prepare massive muscle mass change.

ex.note: Scoop your pinky upwards as you reach the top of the rep, try your best to squeeze your chest as if there was a grape you’re trying to pop between your pecs, keep constant tension
Do not let elbows drift forward or backwards, set pulley to eye level, use a straight bar, and stay over the bar the entire rep, keep the bar as close to your body as possible
If you can’t do weight, then don’t, all I’m worried about is completing the full ROM, if you’re able to do that weight should be added
Move your feet as far down as you can while still being able to get in a full squat, weight progression isn’t my biggest concern here either, focus on getting your full rep
Raise arm slightly bent, as if there’s a string pulling your wrist towards the ceiling, make sure not to shrug shoulders
Squeeze at the top, do no let the weight down till you’re done with you’re set
Go as far down as you can, try to control these reps
Squeeze at the bottom, don’t let the weight drop till your set is over, and take your time with your reps
Control your reps and squeeze at the top
Bring your shoulders slightly back and down and try to keep it a single jointed movement only moving your elbows (keep your wrists and shoulders the same)
These are one of the exercises that I want you to focus more on range of motion than weight progression, focus on the squeeze at the top and take your time with these reps
Neutral grip, squeeze at the top and take your time with progression, keep form consistent
We have not done these yet, adjust pulley to head height, keep your elbows on the same level as your shoulders
Butt machine, need I say more?
